observation.evaluation:
Correctness: CORRECT  
Safety: SAFE  
Issues: Lateral view has inherent right/left localization limitation; the “L” marker on image 1 (CXR3451_IM-1674-3001) indicates a left lateral projection, not independently which pleural space is abnormal, so side assignment depends on the posterior costophrenic-angle blunting pattern.  
Suggestion: If the effusion side is clinically actionable, confirm with a PA/AP radiograph or ultrasound; otherwise no change to the multiple-choice answer.
